unit: HC.HC_MIX static engine, QUALIFIED main ccb3c12f4 (P1 968 / 1,160-cycle price; 2,048 FP32 MAC lanes required by the price: halving lanes gives 1,218 > 1,160)
structure: 8 bank clusters ot_hbm_hc_bank_static (systolic sum chain W->E, 8,192 b between adjacent banks) + core/seq/table + 2 tail units. Bank cluster = 32 CLOSED lane leaves ot_hdc_v41x_hcp_lanes (138.24 x 138.24, hc_lanes_ref-r4; rst_n relayed at the cluster boundary because the view fails native rst_n capture 209.0) + 32 weight macros ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 (174.744 x 70.470) + 16 x macros ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 (94.824 x 41.040).

geometry_estimate.bank_column: leaf pins: s_i W / y E / w_i,x_i S -> one column per bank, per leaf pair [leaf][w macro][x macro][leaf][w macro] with 5.4 um halos: ~485 um per pair x 16 = ~7.76 mm tall, ~0.19 mm wide (weight macro width + halo) = ~1.44 mm2 per bank
geometry_estimate.engine: 8 abutted columns ~1.5 x 7.8 mm = ~11.6 mm2 + core/tails/table strip ~0.4-0.5 mm2 = ~12.0 mm2
geometry_estimate.coordinator_estimate: ~10.4 mm2 (macro 456k + leaf 611k um2 per bank + channels); the column geometry above is the measured-shape bound
geometry_estimate.aspect: sum chain crosses each bank seam on a 7.8 mm face (8,192 b at ~1.1 pins/um): no inter-bank congestion; weight/x write bus (1,024 b) and descriptor broadcast run N-S inside each column

requested_area_mm2: 10.4 minimum, 12.0 for the column layout (preferred: a ~1.6 x 7.9 mm region)
open_alternative: macro re-shape (e.g. 2 x 512x256 per weight slot) to bring the column to ~0.14 mm wide -> ~9.5-10 mm2; needs a macro-compiler shape and a bank RTL edit
status: BLOCKER for the hc_eng hardening floorplan: needs H-DIE region decision (area + aspect)
